source_build: Derived from the immutable evaluation record each entry names, by the reader exulanica.world.society_comparison_reading states for its extraction. An entry names the window it was measured over where that is longer than an hour (window_ticks), and a state family no entry names over an hour reads the comparison protocol's own line.

entries.reason: Derived: the least-margin line on or above every 95th percentile read the record states, measured on the living town's own replay (generated towns at their median and largest populations and a stress town at the society ground's bound), read by the extraction this entry names; the pair budget stays the protocol's.

Derived: the least-margin line on or above every point's dearest read the record states, of any hour of a day or of the day's own read, measured on the living town's own replay of a day hour by hour (generated towns at their median and largest populations and a stress town at the society ground's bound), read by the extraction this entry names; the pair budget stays the protocol's. One point sets its per-decided figure: the town of 52 with everybody decided, whose hour 14 the record read at 2.34 to 6.55 s while the one-minute load rose from 7.74 before the point to 17.55 after it, during another project's build; the bound therefore errs toward fewer decided people.
